g.text: An option stays off until the installer selects it. The core needs no home lab.
KEY: blue AWS | green service | brown data | red identity | gray external | solid core | dashed option
EC2_OPTIONS: empty / copilot / pangolin / pangolin,copilot. Unknown option names stop the scripts.
Each selected public name gets an A record to ElasticIp. Pangolin adds pangolin.<domain>.
Pangolin keeps ok-auth as the ok target. Its ok resource uses the Entra gate, not a second Pangolin login.
DNS provider credentials stay off the core host. Only Pangolin needs the Porkbun pair there for DNS-01.
Frames group related parts. Dashed component boxes mark options; all other component boxes mark the core.
A Newt site uses UDP 51820. UDP 21820 serves clients; both ports open only with Pangolin.
